dataset_versions.vqa: VQA v2 val (v2_Questions_Val_mscoco, v2_Annotations_Val_mscoco); images = COCO val2014 present in train2017
dataset_versions.flickr30k: Flickr30K images (HF mirror nlphuji/flickr30k zip) + Flickr30K Entities annotations, official test split

selection_rules.coco: val2017 images with >=1 instance and captions; 60% containing person, 40% not; random (seed)
selection_rules.vqa: >=3 VQA v2 val questions; image file in COCO train2017; not in COCO subset
selection_rules.vg: VG images without coco_id that have >=1 object mapped to the clothing lexicon
selection_rules.flickr30k: random from Flickr30K Entities official test split
selection_rules.dedup: md5 exact + dHash(64-bit) Hamming<=4, priority coco>vqa>vg>flickr30k
selection_rules.validation: decodable by PIL, min side >= 64 px
